//: Templates ask for the steps, name the checks CI runs, and send security reports to the private channel, with nothing changed outside .github.
prompt: Add Issue And Pull Request Templates
title: The templates ask for the steps, name the real checks, and send security reports away

files.CONTRIBUTING.md:
# Contributing

Before a pull request, run both checks:

    python3 check_style.py
    python3 -m unittest
files.SECURITY.md:
# Security Policy

Report a vulnerability privately to security@example.com, never in a public issue.
files.check_style.py:
import pathlib
import sys

long = [str(path) for path in sorted(pathlib.Path('.').glob('*.py'))
        if any(len(line) > 100 for line in path.read_text().splitlines())]
sys.exit(1 if long else 0)
files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on: [push, pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 check_style.py
      - run: python3 -m unittest

argv:
import pathlib
import subprocess

changed = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-files', '--modified', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], capture_output=True,
                         text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
assert changed and all(name.startswith('.github/') for name in changed), f'changed outside .github: {changed}'
pull = [path for path in ('.github/pull_request_template.md', '.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md')
        if pathlib.Path(path).is_file()]
assert pull, 'no pull request template'
text = pathlib.Path(pull[0]).read_text()
assert 'check_style.py' in text and 'unittest' in text, 'the checklist does not name the checks CI runs'
forms = list(pathlib.Path('.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE').glob('*'))
assert forms, 'no issue templates'
everything = '\n'.join(path.read_text() for path in forms)
assert 'step' in everything.lower(), 'no template asks for the steps'
assert 'SECURITY.md' in everything or 'security@example.com' in everything, 'security reports are not sent away'

proof:
mkdir -p "$(dirname .github/pull_request_template.md)" && cat > .github/pull_request_template.md <<'EVAL_EOF'
## What Changed And Why

## How It Was Tested

- [ ] `python3 check_style.py` passes
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest` passes
EVAL_EOF
mkdir -p "$(dirname .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml)" && cat > .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml <<'EVAL_EOF'
name: Bug report
description: Something does not work as it should
body:
  - type: input
    id: version
    attributes:
      label: Version
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: steps
    attributes:
      label: Steps to reproduce
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: expected
    attributes:
      label: What happened, and what should have
    validations:
      required: true
EVAL_EOF
mkdir -p "$(dirname .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml)" && cat > .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml <<'EVAL_EOF'
blank_issues_enabled: false
contact_links:
  - name: Report a vulnerability
    url: https://github.com/example/shop/blob/main/SECURITY.md
    about: Report security problems privately, as SECURITY.md says, never in a public issue.
EVAL_EOF
